name: Jim Thompson silk scarf
about: A Thai silk scarf from a well-known Thai silk brand. It reflects Bangkok's long history with silk weaving.
tip: Prices differ a lot by size, so compare the size you want before you buy.

name: Benjarong ceramic small cup
about: A multicolored Thai porcelain style, traditionally made by hand. It is a classic Bangkok craft gift.
tip: Check whether it is handmade and whether it is safe for food use.

name: Thai herbal balm
about: A traditional Thai herbal balm with a strong, familiar scent. It is a popular small gift from Bangkok.
tip: Read the label for external-use notes and check the ingredients.
